notes.title: Update Version 2.6.43 Available
notes.content: Update version 2.6.43 is available, and contains several network multiplayer bug fixes, as well as other minor improvements and optimizations.

notes.title: Update Version 2.6.31 Now Available
notes.content:
Update Version 2.6.31 includes the following improvements:

* Performance optimizations for several scenes, including slopes and jump hill.
* Jump Hill now includes the new style trees.
* New loading screen with event controller instructions, so you can familiarize with the controls for an event while the scene loads.
* New finish line banners for sled events.
* A bug which was preventing the network multiplayer lobby to initialize is fixed.

notes.title: Update Version 2.6.29 Now Available
notes.content:
In addition the the new slope course Whirlwind Bluff, and the new Local Split Screen Multiplayer features recently added, BSL Winter Games Challenge has now received a graphics update improving the older sled runs and slopes with improvements carried over from the new Whirlwind Bluff slope.

This update includes the new style trees, reduced fog, and improved lighting and shading throughout the game.

Also included are some minor bug fixes, most notably an audio bug we found in the new split screen sled events is now fixed.

Our thanks to all for playing BSL Winter Games Challenge, and we hope you are enjoying the recent improvements.

notes.title: New Version 2.6.22 - Split Screen Multiplayer
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce the addition of Split Screen Multiplayer mode for all events in BSL Winter Games Challenge.

Local split screen multiplayer mode allows you to compete with family and friends in split screen using two game controllers, or on opposite ends of the keyboard. Game controller assignments are identical to single player mode. Keys for local multiplayer mode are as follows.

PLAYER 1 - using WSAD cluster
Steer: [a] and [d]
Boost: [r] or [w]
Brake: [s] or [f]
Jump: [r] or [space]
Fire1: [z] - stunt category 1 in slope events
Fire2: [x] - stunt category 2 in slope events and chase cam in sled events
Fire3: [c] - stunt category 3 in slope events and driver cam in sled events

PLAYER 2 - using keyboard number pad
Steer: [4] and [6]
Boost: [8] or [-]
Brake: [5] or [+]
Jump: [0] or [9]
Fire1: [1]
Fire2: [2]
Fire3: [3]

Also included in this update is a new easier to use leaderboard interface screen, as well as other minor bug fixes and improvements.

notes.title: Major Update Version 2.5.0
notes.content:
New speed trail for Snowboard and Skiing, "Whirlwind Bluff" featuring:

• Next generation scenery.
• High speed downhill racing with hairpin turns for best time score.
• High jumps to perform tricks for bonus score.
• Hidden shortcut tracks, if you can find them!!!!!
• It is said the mountain is prone to whirlwinds, so watch out.

notes.title: Update Version 2.4.22 Released
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce the release of BSL Winter Games Challenge version 2.4.22 which includes the following improvements

• Improved Steering: In response to user feedback, the steering now adapts to your current speed and is less sensitive the faster you are moving.

• Improved Braking: The brakes for the sleds are improved and respond more naturally than before, making it easier to fine tune your speed going into turns.

• Improved Lighting and Shaders: The lighting and shaders for better visual appearance have been improved for all events and locations.

• Spectators: New animated spectators to cheer for you as you compete for new records.

notes.title: New Update Version 2.4.01 Now Available! Gameplay and UI Improvements.
notes.content:
We're listening!

Based on feedback from users, we have made some adjustments to BSL Winter Games Challenge.

First, we have reduced collision detection sensitivity for sledding events. It is still possible to trigger a crash if you hit a wall hard, but for minor collisions you will likely bounce off the wall and keep going. Of course you still want to drive your sled carefully, as any collision will slow you down and you will lose valuable seconds on the clock.

Second, we have made the slide rail obstacle for snowboard events easier. In previous versions, if you attempted the slide rail and failed to complete the slide accurately, you would crash. Now in most cases, if you fail to complete the slide, you will just jump back down to the slope and keep going. In this case, you will not get the bonus points for a successful slide rail execution, but you also won't crash and be sent back to the last checkpoint. If you jump off the slide rail early and subsequently crash into the rail, it is still possible to crash of course.

Third, we have added arrow buttons to selection panels in the main menu for event, team and course selection. If navigating with a game controller or keyboard, these are much easier to use. If you are using a mouse, these new arrow buttons will work for you as well, but you also have the old scrollbar and direct click to select if you prefer. The choice is yours.

Finally, we would like to extend a special thank you to Jennyverse ( http://www.youtube.com/jennyverselive ) who provided a detailed video which helped us to see areas where new users were specifically having problems, and was very helpful with feedback for this update. 

Thanks also to all of our users, and we hope you will enjoy the update.

notes.title: Major Update 2.4.0 - New Event: Ski Jump
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce the addition of Ski Jump to the growing list of events available in BSL Winter Games Challenge.

The goal is simple, accelerate down the ramp and soar through the air as far as possible before touching down on the hill far below.

To achieve your best distance, you will have to learn to read the wind conditions and adjust your technique appropriately. At the same time, you also have to maintain the center line of the jump hill to minimize the form deduction to your score.

This update also includes other improvements and bug fixes.

notes.title: Update 2.3.20.137 - Adjusted Slalom Scoring
notes.content: This update adjusts the scoring for slalom events. Missed gates now have a larger impact on your score.

notes.title: Patch version 2.3.15 - fixed mouse issue in menu
notes.content: Update version 2.3.14 had a minor issue with mouse input in the main menu. This is now fixed with this patch update.

notes.title: Minor Update Available: Version 2.3.14
notes.content:
• Improved UI navigation using game controller.
• Miscellaneous fixes and improvements

** There was a minor issue with the first upload of this version. This has now been corrected. If you downloaded the update already and the game failed to start, please check for the new patch update and try again. Our apologies for any inconvenience. **

notes.title: Minor Update 2.3.02 - Slope Event Physics Update
notes.content: We have released a minor update (v2.3.02) fixing a bug affecting slope event physics.

notes.title: Minor Update v2.3.01 - Slalom Skiing Leaderboard
notes.content: This update corrects the leaderboard screen so that you can now view your standing for slalom skiing events.

notes.title: Major Update: 2.3.0: Slalom Skiing
notes.content:
We are please to announce the release of our latest new event; Slalom Skiing.

Race against the clock on 3 new slalom courses to beat your own best time, and the best times of your friends on the leaderboards. Or, race head to head against your friends in multi-player competition.

notes.title: Major Update Version 2.2.0 - Multiplayer Added for Snowboard Events
notes.content: Compete against your friends and for top position on the multiplayer leaderboards in snowboard events.

notes.title: Major Update version 2.1.09 - New Event - Snowboarding!
notes.content: We are pleased to announce our latest update for BSL Winter Games Challenge, which adds an exciting new event, Snowboarding. Also included are three challenging slopes packed with dramatic high speed downhill runs, obstacles, and trick apparatus so you can earn bonus points to compete for the highest score.

notes.title: Major Update - New Multiplayer Mode and Leaderboards Available Now! (v2.0.2)
notes.content: Play against friends and family on-line in all events and locations, and compete for bragging rights and top positions in the new multiplayer leaderboards.

notes.title: New Update Available - v.1.23
notes.content:
Update version 1.23 is now available.

-  [Fixed] - In the case of a user uninstalling the game after posting their results to a leaderboard, then reinstalling, it was possible to overwrite a high standing with a lower one.

- [Fixed] - If a user viewed the leaderboard before a result was finished uploading, the upload was interupted and could fail to complete.

notes.title: Major Update (v1.22) Now Available!
notes.content:
[HOTFIX AVAILABLE - for anyone who downloaded the initial version 1.20 update  and is having problems with mouse control mode, please try again with the version 1.22 hotfix update]



We're listening to your feedback.

Some users have reported difficulty with the game, specifically with driving control as well as with crash sensitivity.

Our desire is that all who purchase our game have an enjoyable experience, so we have stepped back and made adjustments to the physics and controls for all of the sleds featured in BSL Winter Games Challenge.

We thank those users who have provided us with valuable feedback, both positive and negative, which has helped us to improve the game for you.

We are pleased with the results, and we hope you are as well.



New in version 1.22.

- Blades are sharper at the rear of the sled and duller at the front, resulting in improved natural tracking of the curves of each course.

- Steering sensitivity is adjusted for easier fine control.

- Crash detection sensitivity is significantly reduced for the easiest setting. The highest difficult setting is the same as it was before, for those who preferred the challenge it presented. With the new easy setting, it will allow you to continue your run for all but the highest intensity of impacts. Of course your time will still be affected by collisions, so by all means, drive carefully if you are looking for a high standing on the leaderboard.

- When driving in mouse control mode, the mouse cursor is now hidden and locked, removing the visual distraction, as well as generally improving the functionality and ease of use for mouse control mode. Press F4 to pause the game and re-enable the mouse cursor.

- For convenient reference, the F1 - F4 keys are labeled on the in-game top-bar menu, controlling camera modes and pause menu, so you will remember the key command you need at a glance.

HOTFIX version 1.22
- Fixes an issue with the mouse cursor in version 1.20 initial update release.
